roads.name: Highway 547
words: Properly twisty: 21 curves in 4.1 miles, about 5 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 7,172 to 8,198 ft, with 1,106 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 45 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.49 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
